line: Life feels like a fever dream.
I haven't had my caffeine yet don't bother me.
They felt themselves drifting apart, like icebergs in the ocean.
Seen too many screens. Perhaps a little too much. I should take a walk.
I wish we could be friends, but there's something about the way you lick your envelopes.
High School is over, life has begun.
I'm spending my days in isolation.
I think that sometimes I get way too excited, and then the fun ends.
Shelter in Place! Shelter in Place!
America you lost everything and now you have nothing.
I haven't taken a shower in weeks. I'm starting to smell like antiques.
Instead of a refreshing burst of flavour, I am met with a hairy, fuzzy, sticky, smelly, gray lump.
